definition: the way something is used, or the amount that is used
sentence: Water {usage} rises sharply in the summer months.
translation: Потребление воды резко растёт в летние месяцы.

definition: a heavy metal object dropped from a boat to keep it in one place
sentence: The captain dropped the {anchor} in the quiet bay.
translation: Капитан бросил якорь в тихой бухте.

definition: the part of a phone you hold to your ear
sentence: He picked up the {receiver} and dialed the number.
translation: Он снял трубку и набрал номер.

definition: a ship, car or plane that has been badly damaged or destroyed
sentence: Divers found the {wreck} of the ship on the sea bed.
translation: Водолазы нашли обломки корабля на морском дне.

definition: a woman in stories who has magic powers, usually evil ones
sentence: The {witch} in the story lives in a house made of cake.
translation: Ведьма в сказке живёт в доме из пирога.

definition: the number 40
sentence: The bus can carry {forty} passengers.
translation: Автобус вмещает сорок пассажиров.

definition: a set of steps that a computer follows to solve a problem
sentence: The {algorithm} decides which videos you see next.
translation: Алгоритм решает, какие видео вы увидите дальше.

definition: something that makes you want to work harder or do something
sentence: A free lunch is a good {incentive} to come to the office.
translation: Бесплатный обед — хороший стимул приходить в офис.

definition: one of the four books of the Bible about Jesus, or religious music
sentence: The choir sang {gospel} songs in the church on Sunday.
translation: Хор пел госпел в церкви в воскресенье.

definition: a metal pin that holds things together, or a bar that locks a door
sentence: One {bolt} on the wheel was loose.
translation: Один болт на колесе был ослаблен.

definition: a job that needs special training and education, such as a doctor or lawyer
sentence: Teaching is a {profession} that needs patience.
translation: Преподавание — профессия, требующая терпения.

definition: the act of handing in a document or plan to be considered
sentence: The deadline for {submission} of essays is Friday.
translation: Крайний срок подачи эссе — пятница.

definition: the large entrance hall of a hotel, or a group that tries to influence politicians
sentence: We waited for our friends in the hotel {lobby}.
translation: Мы ждали друзей в холле отеля.

definition: a group of similar things that are close together
sentence: A {cluster} of small houses stood by the river.
translation: У реки стояла группа маленьких домов.

definition: to make the sound of a word or letter in a particular way
sentence: How do you {pronounce} your surname?
translation: Как произносится ваша фамилия?

definition: a person who does not win a game, or who is never successful
sentence: The {loser} of the match shook hands with the winner.
translation: Проигравший матч пожал руку победителю.

definition: to cut hair off the face or body with a razor
sentence: He forgot to {shave} before the interview.
translation: Он забыл побриться перед собеседованием.

definition: a device that notices heat, light, movement or sound and reacts to it
sentence: A {sensor} turns on the lights when someone enters the room.
translation: Датчик включает свет, когда кто-то входит в комнату.

definition: happening or coming one after the other in turns, or different from the usual
sentence: The bus runs on {alternate} days: Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
translation: Автобус ходит через день: в понедельник, среду и пятницу.

definition: to stay somewhere and pay rent, or to become stuck in a place
sentence: The students {lodge} with local families during the course.
translation: Во время курса студенты живут у местных семей.

definition: a figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal
sentence: A {statue} of the poet stands in the main square.
translation: На главной площади стоит статуя поэта.

definition: the sending out of gas, heat or light into the air
sentence: The new law limits the {emission} of smoke from factories.
translation: Новый закон ограничивает выбросы дыма с заводов.

definition: the act of traveling through an unknown place to learn about it
sentence: The {exploration} of the cave took the team three days.
translation: Исследование пещеры заняло у команды три дня.

definition: to make a low continuous sound, like a bee
sentence: Flies {buzz} around the kitchen all summer.
translation: Мухи всё лето жужжат по кухне.

definition: very thick strong string made of many threads turned together
sentence: Tie the boat to the post with a {rope}.
translation: Привяжи лодку к столбу верёвкой.

definition: the quality of being good and deserving praise
sentence: Students are chosen on {merit}, not on money.
translation: Студентов отбирают по заслугам, а не по деньгам.

definition: to go with someone to protect or guide them
sentence: Two police officers will {escort} the witness to court.
translation: Двое полицейских будут сопровождать свидетеля в суд.

definition: a substance used with water for washing your body or clothes
sentence: Wash your hands with {soap} before dinner.
translation: Вымой руки с мылом перед ужином.

definition: to cut something into pieces with a knife or an axe
sentence: {Chop} the onions and fry them in butter.
translation: Нарежь лук и обжарь в масле.

definition: the act of putting things into groups by type, or the group something belongs to
sentence: The {classification} of plants is based on their flowers.
translation: Классификация растений основана на их цветках.

definition: the person in a court who is accused of a crime
sentence: The {defendant} said he was at home on the night of the robbery.
translation: Подсудимый сказал, что в ночь ограбления был дома.

definition: a very small living thing that can cause disease; the plural is bacteria
sentence: A single {bacterium} can multiply into millions in a day.
translation: Одна бактерия может размножиться до миллионов за день.

definition: by chance; without meaning to
sentence: I {accidentally} deleted the photos from my phone.
translation: Я случайно удалил фотографии с телефона.

definition: cheap enough for most people to buy
sentence: The city needs more {affordable} homes for young families.
translation: Городу нужно больше доступного жилья для молодых семей.

definition: the study of living things
sentence: We learned about the human heart in {biology} class.
translation: На уроке биологии мы изучали сердце человека.

definition: for a short time, or in a few words
sentence: She spoke {briefly} and then sat down.
translation: Она говорила недолго, а затем села.

definition: the legal right to look after a child, or being kept in prison
sentence: The mother was given {custody} of the children.
translation: Мать получила опеку над детьми.

definition: attractive, used especially of men
sentence: Her new boyfriend is tall and {handsome}.
translation: Её новый парень высокий и красивый.

definition: the process of joining different groups or systems into one
sentence: The {integration} of the two schools took a year.
translation: Объединение двух школ заняло год.

definition: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
sentence: I trust him because he has real {integrity}.
translation: Я ему доверяю, потому что он по-настоящему порядочный человек.

definition: allowed by law, or reasonable and acceptable
sentence: He has a {legitimate} reason for missing the meeting.
translation: У него уважительная причина пропустить встречу.

definition: a bright flash of light in the sky during a storm
sentence: {Lightning} struck the old oak tree.
translation: Молния ударила в старый дуб.

definition: produced by magic, or wonderful and exciting
sentence: The castle looked {magical} in the snow.
translation: Замок в снегу выглядел волшебно.

definition: very bad to see, smell or deal with, or not kind
sentence: There is a {nasty} smell coming from the drain.
translation: Из слива идёт отвратительный запах.

definition: enjoyable or friendly
sentence: We spent a {pleasant} afternoon by the lake.
translation: Мы провели приятный день у озера.

definition: producing a lot, or achieving good results
sentence: The meeting was short but {productive}.
translation: Встреча была короткой, но продуктивной.

definition: without danger or harm
sentence: The plane landed {safely} despite the storm.
translation: Самолёт приземлился благополучно, несмотря на бурю.

definition: the state of not having a job, or the number of people without jobs
sentence: {Unemployment} rose sharply after the factory closed.
translation: Безработица резко выросла после закрытия завода.

definition: the state of being joined together or in agreement
sentence: The team's {unity} helped it win the final.
translation: Сплочённость команды помогла ей выиграть финал.

definition: of no use; not helping at all
sentence: The map was {useless} because it was fifty years old.
translation: Карта была бесполезна, потому что ей было пятьдесят лет.

definition: a device that gives light, usually standing on a table or the floor
sentence: She turned on the {lamp} by the bed and started to read.
translation: Она включила лампу у кровати и начала читать.

definition: a system that uses radio waves to find the position of ships, planes or storms
sentence: The {radar} showed a storm moving towards the coast.
translation: Радар показал бурю, движущуюся к побережью.

definition: to let liquid fall out of a container by accident
sentence: Be careful not to {spill} the milk on the table.
translation: Осторожно, не пролей молоко на стол.

definition: to find out what illness someone has
sentence: The doctor was able to {diagnose} the illness from one blood test.
translation: Врач смог поставить диагноз по одному анализу крови.

definition: the official power of a court or authority to make legal decisions in an area
sentence: The court has no {jurisdiction} over crimes committed abroad.
translation: Суд не имеет полномочий по преступлениям, совершённым за границей.

definition: a problem taken to a court of law for a decision
sentence: The company faces a {lawsuit} from angry customers.
translation: Компании грозит судебный иск от недовольных клиентов.

definition: able to cause death
sentence: The snake's bite is {deadly} without quick treatment.
translation: Укус этой змеи смертелен без быстрого лечения.

definition: to open a lock, usually with a key
sentence: Use this key to {unlock} the back door.
translation: Этим ключом открой заднюю дверь.

definition: a pattern of crossing lines forming squares, or a network of power lines
sentence: The city streets form a {grid}, so it is easy to find your way.
translation: Улицы города образуют сетку, поэтому ориентироваться легко.

definition: a small flat case for carrying money and cards
sentence: I left my {wallet} on the kitchen table.
translation: Я оставил бумажник на кухонном столе.

definition: a person who plays on the same team as you
sentence: She passed the ball to a {teammate} near the goal.
translation: Она отдала мяч партнёру по команде у ворот.

definition: to cook food such as bread or cakes in an oven
sentence: We {bake} fresh bread every Sunday morning.
translation: Мы печём свежий хлеб каждое воскресенье утром.

definition: an official mark in a passport that lets you enter a country
sentence: You need a {visa} to work in that country.
translation: Для работы в этой стране нужна виза.

definition: a thick warm cover for a bed
sentence: She pulled the {blanket} up to her chin.
translation: Она натянула одеяло до подбородка.

definition: a collection of drawings or work that shows your skill, or a set of investments
sentence: The designer showed her {portfolio} at the interview.
translation: Дизайнер показала своё портфолио на собеседовании.

definition: a medical test given to many people to find a disease early
sentence: Free cancer {screening} is offered to everyone over fifty.
translation: Бесплатное обследование на рак предлагают всем старше пятидесяти.

definition: completely new and causing great change, or relating to a revolution
sentence: The telephone was a {revolutionary} invention.
translation: Телефон был революционным изобретением.

definition: a violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the Atlantic
sentence: The {hurricane} destroyed hundreds of homes on the coast.
translation: Ураган разрушил сотни домов на побережье.

definition: something that encourages you to act, or a sharp object on a rider's boot
sentence: The prize was a {spur} to work harder.
translation: Приз стал стимулом работать усерднее.

definition: a book in which you write what happens to you each day
sentence: She has kept a {diary} since she was ten.
translation: Она ведёт дневник с десяти лет.

definition: an official order that limits trade with a country, or a punishment
sentence: The {sanction} stopped the country from selling its oil.
translation: Санкция не позволила стране продавать нефть.

definition: a written or spoken request to come to an event
sentence: We received an {invitation} to their wedding.
translation: Мы получили приглашение на их свадьбу.

definition: something made by combining two or more things
sentence: Pour the {mixture} into a hot pan.
translation: Вылей смесь на горячую сковороду.

definition: a mathematical statement that two amounts are equal, written with a sign
sentence: Solve the {equation} to find the value of x.
translation: Реши уравнение, чтобы найти значение x.

definition: a rule or fact that limits something, or a weakness
sentence: The old phone has one {limitation}: the battery dies fast.
translation: У старого телефона одно ограничение: батарея быстро садится.

definition: the act of letting someone leave a hospital or the army
sentence: The patient's {discharge} from hospital is planned for Monday.
translation: Выписка пациента из больницы запланирована на понедельник.

definition: a covering for the hand with a separate part for each finger
sentence: He lost one {glove} in the snow.
translation: Он потерял одну перчатку в снегу.

definition: a small mistake or weakness that makes something not perfect
sentence: The plan has one {flaw}: nobody has a car.
translation: В плане один изъян: ни у кого нет машины.

definition: a tall plant with large yellow grains used as food
sentence: We ate sweet {corn} straight from the field.
translation: Мы ели сладкую кукурузу прямо с поля.

definition: the food inside a pie or sandwich, or material put into a bad tooth
sentence: The pie has a {filling} of apples and raisins.
translation: У пирога начинка из яблок и изюма.

definition: the group of people with the power to make laws for a country or state
sentence: The state {legislature} voted to raise the minimum wage.
translation: Законодательное собрание штата проголосовало за повышение минимальной зарплаты.

definition: a small creature with six legs and often wings, such as a fly or bee
sentence: An {insect} flew into my eye while I was cycling.
translation: Насекомое влетело мне в глаз, когда я ехал на велосипеде.

definition: a possible effect or result, or something suggested but not said directly
sentence: The decision has an {implication} for every school in the city.
translation: Решение имеет последствия для каждой школы в городе.

definition: a type of music in which words are spoken quickly over a strong beat
sentence: He listens to {rap} on his way to school.
translation: По дороге в школу он слушает рэп.

definition: full of bad feeling for a long time because of something that was not fair
sentence: He's still {bitter} about losing that job.
translation: Он до сих пор зол из-за потери той работы.

definition: quick at learning and understanding, or showing skill
sentence: It was a {clever} idea to use the old door as a table.
translation: Было умно использовать старую дверь как стол.

definition: happening without stopping
sentence: The {continuous} noise from the road kept me awake.
translation: Непрерывный шум с дороги не давал мне спать.

definition: in a way that is right, true or proper
sentence: You answered every question on the test {correctly}.
translation: Ты ответил на все вопросы теста правильно.

definition: slowly, by small steps over a period of time
sentence: The days are {gradually} getting longer.
translation: Дни постепенно становятся длиннее.

definition: the force that pulls objects towards the Earth
sentence: Because of {gravity}, the apple fell to the ground.
translation: Из-за силы тяжести яблоко упало на землю.

definition: exactly the same
sentence: The twins wore {identical} blue dresses.
translation: Близнецы были в одинаковых синих платьях.

definition: relating to an empire or its ruler
sentence: The {imperial} palace is now a museum.
translation: Императорский дворец теперь музей.

definition: according to the law
sentence: You are {legally} an adult at eighteen.
translation: С восемнадцати лет ты юридически совершеннолетний.

definition: words or ideas that are stupid or have no meaning
sentence: Stop talking {nonsense} and tell me what happened.
translation: Хватит болтать ерунду, расскажи, что случилось.

definition: working and ready to be used, or relating to the daily running of a business
sentence: The new airport will be fully {operational} by May.
translation: Новый аэропорт будет полностью работать к маю.

definition: many times; again and again
sentence: He {repeatedly} asked the same question.
translation: Он снова и снова задавал один и тот же вопрос.

definition: the system of owning people and forcing them to work without pay
sentence: {Slavery} was ended in the United States in 1865.
translation: Рабство в Соединённых Штатах отменили в 1865 году.

definition: weak and easy to hurt or attack
sentence: Old people are the most {vulnerable} in this heat.
translation: Пожилые люди больше всех уязвимы в такую жару.

definition: a formal statement given in court about what you know or saw
sentence: Her {testimony} helped to free an innocent man.
translation: Её показания помогли освободить невиновного.

definition: to make a formal statement in court about what you know or saw
sentence: Three neighbors will {testify} that they heard the shots.
translation: Трое соседей дадут показания, что слышали выстрелы.

definition: a cold dish of green leaves and other raw plants, often with oil
sentence: I had a green {salad} with my fish.
translation: К рыбе я взял зелёный салат.

definition: a shop that sells food and small household goods, or the goods themselves
sentence: The {grocery} on the corner stays open until midnight.
translation: Продуктовый магазин на углу работает до полуночи.

definition: the part of a program that you see and use on the screen
sentence: The app has a simple {interface} that anyone can use.
translation: У приложения простой интерфейс, которым может пользоваться любой.

definition: to fail to notice something important
sentence: I {overlooked} one small mistake and lost the whole bonus.
translation: Я не заметил одну мелкую ошибку и лишился всей премии.

definition: to agree to do a big task and start doing it
sentence: We {undertook} the renovation without any help.
translation: Мы взялись за ремонт без чьей-либо помощи.

definition: an official examination of a company's accounts
sentence: The {audit} found that money was missing from the account.
translation: Аудит показал, что со счёта пропали деньги.

definition: the power given to a government or person to do something, especially after an election
sentence: The party won a clear {mandate} to change the tax system.
translation: Партия получила чёткий мандат на изменение налоговой системы.

definition: to move quietly and secretly so that nobody sees you
sentence: The children tried to {sneak} into the kitchen for cake.
translation: Дети пытались прокрасться на кухню за тортом.

definition: to take someone's attention away from what they are doing
sentence: Please don't {distract} me while I'm driving.
translation: Пожалуйста, не отвлекай меня, пока я за рулём.

definition: to suffer something painful or unpleasant for a long time
sentence: I can't {endure} another winter in this cold flat.
translation: Я не вынесу ещё одну зиму в этой холодной квартире.

definition: the things that will happen to someone, thought to be decided in advance
sentence: She believed it was her {destiny} to become a singer.
translation: Она верила, что стать певицей — её судьба.

definition: a small aircraft without a pilot, controlled from the ground
sentence: The farmer uses a {drone} to check his fields.
translation: Фермер использует дрон, чтобы осматривать поля.

definition: a small animal with long ears and soft fur that lives in holes
sentence: A {rabbit} ran across the garden and hid under the bush.
translation: Кролик пробежал по саду и спрятался под кустом.

definition: a large bird that hunts small animals and has very good eyesight
sentence: A {hawk} circled above the field looking for mice.
translation: Ястреб кружил над полем в поисках мышей.

definition: to look like or be similar to someone or something
sentence: You {resemble} your father when you laugh.
translation: Когда ты смеёшься, ты похож на отца.

definition: a small simple house made of wood, or a room on a ship or plane
sentence: We rented a log {cabin} by the lake for the weekend.
translation: Мы сняли бревенчатый домик у озера на выходные.

definition: the quality of staying faithful to a person, group or belief
sentence: The dog's {loyalty} to its owner never changed.
translation: Преданность собаки хозяину никогда не менялась.

definition: to find your position, or to direct something towards a particular group
sentence: Use the church tower to {orient} yourself in the old town.
translation: Ориентируйся по церковной башне в старом городе.

definition: a room or floor of a building that is below ground level
sentence: We keep old furniture in the {basement}.
translation: Мы храним старую мебель в подвале.

definition: a game or problem that tests your thinking, or something hard to understand
sentence: The children spent the afternoon doing a thousand-piece {puzzle}.
translation: Дети весь день собирали пазл из тысячи деталей.

definition: a tall tree with long thin needles that stay green all year
sentence: A {pine} forest covers the hills behind the town.
translation: Сосновый лес покрывает холмы за городом.

definition: to control the direction of a vehicle or boat
sentence: It is hard to {steer} the boat in such strong wind.
translation: При таком сильном ветре трудно управлять лодкой.

definition: to make someone upset or angry by saying or doing something rude
sentence: I did not mean to {offend} you with my joke.
translation: Я не хотел обидеть тебя своей шуткой.

definition: a surface that is higher at one end, like the side of a hill
sentence: The children rolled down the grassy {slope}.
translation: Дети скатились по травяному склону.

definition: the hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
sentence: He grew a {beard} during the long winter.
translation: За долгую зиму он отрастил бороду.

definition: a small amount of food eaten between meals
sentence: I had an apple as a {snack} after school.
translation: После школы я перекусил яблоком.

definition: to appear in a place often, used of a ghost, or to keep worrying someone
sentence: People say a ghost will {haunt} the old mill at night.
translation: Говорят, по ночам в старой мельнице бродит призрак.

definition: not thinking you are better or more important than others
sentence: He's very {humble} for someone that famous.
translation: Он очень скромный для такого известного человека.

definition: as an extra fact or thing; also
sentence: The room has a sea view; {additionally}, it has a balcony.
translation: В номере вид на море, а кроме того, есть балкон.

definition: a hard brown metal made of copper and tin, or a third-place medal
sentence: The statue is made of {bronze} and stands in the park.
translation: Статуя сделана из бронзы и стоит в парке.

definition: lasting for a long time and difficult to cure, used of an illness
sentence: She suffers from {chronic} back pain.
translation: Она страдает от хронической боли в спине.

definition: a doctor's judgment about what illness a person has
sentence: The {diagnosis} was flu, not anything serious.
translation: Диагноз — грипп, ничего серьёзного.

definition: coming after seven others in order
sentence: It is her {eighth} birthday on Saturday.
translation: В субботу ей исполняется восемь лет.

definition: the soft part of the body under the skin, or the soft part of fruit
sentence: The thorn went deep into the {flesh} of his hand.
translation: Шип глубоко вошёл в мягкие ткани его руки.

definition: willing to give money, help or time freely
sentence: It was {generous} of you to pay for everyone's dinner.
translation: Было щедро с твоей стороны заплатить за ужин для всех.

definition: always supporting a person or group, even in bad times
sentence: He stayed {loyal} to the club through every bad season.
translation: Он оставался верен клубу в каждый неудачный сезон.

definition: a drug made from the dried leaves of a plant, smoked for pleasure
sentence: The use of {marijuana} is legal in some countries.
translation: Употребление марихуаны законно в некоторых странах.

definition: in a way that relates to the mind
sentence: She was {mentally} exhausted after the exams.
translation: После экзаменов она была морально истощена.

definition: to walk slowly around a place without a clear purpose
sentence: We spent the afternoon wandering; it is nice to {wander} through the old streets.
translation: Мы провели день, бродя по городу; приятно блуждать по старым улицам.

definition: too hard, strong or cold, and not kind
sentence: The winters here are {harsh}, with wind and ice.
translation: Зимы здесь суровые, с ветром и льдом.

definition: an open container with a handle for carrying water
sentence: Fill the {bucket} with water and wash the car.
translation: Наполни ведро водой и помой машину.

definition: the building where the ambassador and officials of a foreign country work
sentence: You can renew your passport at the {embassy}.
translation: Паспорт можно продлить в посольстве.

definition: the movement of large numbers of people or animals from one place to another
sentence: The {migration} of birds to the south begins in October.
translation: Миграция птиц на юг начинается в октябре.

definition: a short fight or a strong disagreement
sentence: There was a {clash} between police and protesters in the square.
translation: На площади произошло столкновение между полицией и протестующими.

definition: a careful investigation, or a small spacecraft sent to explore space
sentence: The space {probe} sent back pictures of Mars.
translation: Космический зонд передал снимки Марса.

definition: a vehicle with two wheels and an engine
sentence: He rides a {motorcycle} to work every day.
translation: Он каждый день ездит на работу на мотоцикле.

definition: a thin object with a sharp point, or a sudden increase
sentence: The fence has a metal {spike} on top of each post.
translation: На каждом столбе забора сверху металлический шип.

definition: a person who buys and sells goods or shares
sentence: The {trader} sells fruit at the market every Saturday.
translation: Торговец продаёт фрукты на рынке каждую субботу.

definition: a lot of talk and advertising that makes something seem more important than it is
sentence: After all the {hype}, the film was quite boring.
translation: После всей шумихи фильм оказался довольно скучным.

definition: with the name not known or not given
sentence: The police received an {anonymous} letter about the robbery.
translation: Полиция получила анонимное письмо об ограблении.

definition: relating to art, or good at creating art
sentence: She comes from an {artistic} family of painters and musicians.
translation: Она из творческой семьи художников и музыкантов.

definition: the number of people present at an event, or the act of being present
sentence: {Attendance} at the concert was higher than expected.
translation: Посещаемость концерта оказалась выше ожидаемой.

definition: the activity of flying aircraft, or the business of making them
sentence: He works in {aviation} as an engineer for a big airline.
translation: Он работает в авиации инженером крупной авиакомпании.

definition: loved very much
sentence: The town said goodbye to its {beloved} old doctor.
translation: Город попрощался со своим любимым старым доктором.

definition: relating to a colony or to the time when a country controlled other countries
sentence: The old town has many {colonial} buildings from the 1700s.
translation: В старом городе много колониальных зданий XVIII века.

definition: the act of obeying a rule, law or request
sentence: The factory was checked for {compliance} with safety rules.
translation: Завод проверили на соблюдение правил безопасности.

definition: opposite in meaning or direction
sentence: {Contrary} to what people think, the river is not deep.
translation: Вопреки тому, что думают люди, река неглубокая.

definition: a serious illness in which the body cannot control the sugar in the blood
sentence: People with {diabetes} must watch what they eat.
translation: Людям с диабетом нужно следить за питанием.

definition: the rules of a language for making sentences
sentence: English {grammar} is easier than Russian grammar.
translation: Английская грамматика проще русской.

definition: a curved piece of glass in a camera, pair of glasses or telescope
sentence: The camera {lens} was scratched, so every photo was blurry.
translation: Объектив камеры был поцарапан, поэтому все фото получились размытыми.

definition: having the power to attract iron, or very attractive
sentence: The {magnetic} door closes by itself.
translation: Магнитная дверь закрывается сама.

definition: strange and not understood or explained
sentence: A {mysterious} light appeared over the lake at night.
translation: Ночью над озером появился загадочный свет.

definition: not complete, or preferring one side unfairly
sentence: The report gives only a {partial} picture of the problem.
translation: Отчёт даёт лишь частичную картину проблемы.

definition: information, often false, spread to make people support a political idea
sentence: The posters were {propaganda} for the ruling party.
translation: Плакаты были пропагандой правящей партии.

definition: at the same time
sentence: The two bombs exploded {simultaneously} in different parts of the city.
translation: Две бомбы взорвались одновременно в разных частях города.

definition: the act of watching a person or place carefully, often secretly
sentence: The police kept the house under {surveillance} for a week.
translation: Полиция неделю держала дом под наблюдением.

definition: to be the cause or basis of something
sentence: Fear and poverty {underlie} most of the violence in the area.
translation: Страх и бедность лежат в основе большей части насилия в этом районе.

definition: not treating people equally or in the right way
sentence: It is {unfair} to punish the whole class for one student's mistake.
translation: Несправедливо наказывать весь класс за ошибку одного ученика.

definition: a small piece of paper, cloth or food, or old metal to be reused
sentence: He wrote her number on a {scrap} of paper.
translation: Он записал её номер на клочке бумаги.

definition: the mother of your mother or father
sentence: My {grandmother} bakes the best apple pie in the world.
translation: Моя бабушка печёт лучший в мире яблочный пирог.

definition: a drawing that shows how two sets of numbers are related, using lines or bars
sentence: The {graph} shows how prices rose over ten years.
translation: График показывает, как росли цены за десять лет.

definition: the bones of the head
sentence: The doctors checked for damage to his {skull} after the crash.
translation: Врачи проверили, не повреждён ли его череп после аварии.

definition: to raise something to a higher level or position
sentence: {Elevate} your leg to reduce the swelling.
translation: Подними ногу повыше, чтобы уменьшить отёк.

definition: the loud noise that follows lightning in a storm
sentence: The dog hides under the bed when it hears {thunder}.
translation: Собака прячется под кровать, когда слышит гром.

definition: the line where the sky seems to meet the land or sea
sentence: A ship appeared on the {horizon} at sunset.
translation: На закате на горизонте появился корабль.

definition: a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed
sentence: He has a small {scar} above his left eye.
translation: У него маленький шрам над левым глазом.

definition: a young dog
sentence: The {puppy} chewed every shoe in the house.
translation: Щенок сгрыз все ботинки в доме.

definition: the amount by which money spent is more than money received
sentence: The city has a {deficit} of ten million dollars this year.
translation: В этом году у города дефицит в десять миллионов долларов.

definition: a small room or cupboard for storing clothes
sentence: Her {closet} is full of shoes she never wears.
translation: Её шкаф полон туфель, которые она никогда не носит.

definition: a clear difference between two similar things
sentence: There's a big {distinction} between being tired and being lazy.
translation: Есть большая разница между усталостью и ленью.

definition: the curved path of a planet or satellite around a larger object in space
sentence: The satellite stays in {orbit} for about ten years.
translation: Спутник остаётся на орбите около десяти лет.

definition: a creature in stories that drinks people's blood at night
sentence: In the film, the {vampire} cannot go out in daylight.
translation: В фильме вампир не может выходить при дневном свете.

definition: to give out a soft, steady light
sentence: The coals still {glow} red after the fire has died.
translation: Угли всё ещё светятся красным после того, как огонь погас.

definition: very unpleasant, especially in smell or taste
sentence: A {foul} smell came from the broken drain.
translation: Из сломанного слива шёл отвратительный запах.

definition: a dead body in stories that has been brought back to life
sentence: In the film, a {zombie} chases the heroes through an empty city.
translation: В фильме зомби гонится за героями по пустому городу.

definition: something that has been designed or created for the first time
sentence: The telephone was the greatest {invention} of its time.
translation: Телефон был величайшим изобретением своего времени.

definition: an amount of money you pay regularly for a magazine, service or membership
sentence: My gym {subscription} costs forty dollars a month.
translation: Мой абонемент в спортзал стоит сорок долларов в месяц.

definition: a container made of thin strips of wood or plastic, often with a handle
sentence: She carried the eggs home in a {basket}.
translation: Она принесла яйца домой в корзине.

definition: a thin pointed piece of metal used for sewing or injections
sentence: I cannot get the thread through the {needle}.
translation: Я не могу вдеть нитку в иголку.

definition: to give something to someone and receive something else in return
sentence: Let's {swap} seats so you can see the screen.
translation: Давай поменяемся местами, чтобы тебе было видно экран.

definition: a person who studies or writes about history
sentence: The {historian} found letters from a soldier in the war.
translation: Историк нашёл письма солдата с войны.

definition: a small green or black fruit with a bitter taste, eaten or used for oil
sentence: Add an {olive} to each glass before serving.
translation: Положи по оливке в каждый бокал перед подачей.

definition: a large group or wide range of things
sentence: The shop has an {array} of cheeses from every region.
translation: В магазине широкий выбор сыров из всех регионов.

definition: a yellow fruit with a very sour taste
sentence: Squeeze half a {lemon} into the tea.
translation: Выжми половину лимона в чай.

definition: a detailed description of how something should be made or what it should do
sentence: The {specification} says the bridge must carry forty tons.
translation: В спецификации сказано, что мост должен выдерживать сорок тонн.

definition: to speak very quietly so that only a person close to you can hear
sentence: She leaned over to {whisper} the answer in my ear.
translation: Она наклонилась, чтобы шепнуть мне ответ на ухо.

definition: the central and most important part of a place or system
sentence: The airport is the main {hub} for flights to Asia.
translation: Аэропорт — главный узел для рейсов в Азию.

definition: to collect information from different places and put it into a list or book
sentence: The teacher will {compile} a list of books for the summer.
translation: Учитель составит список книг на лето.

definition: an official document that proves who you are, used when traveling abroad
sentence: Don't forget your {passport} for the flight.
translation: Не забудь паспорт на рейс.

definition: a fast short run, or a small amount of something added
sentence: He made a {dash} for the bus as the doors closed.
translation: Он рванул к автобусу, когда двери закрывались.

definition: a place to live or stay, such as a hotel or flat
sentence: The price of the trip includes flights and {accommodation}.
translation: В стоимость поездки входят перелёт и проживание.

definition: a person whose job is to give advice on a subject
sentence: She spoke to a financial {advisor} before buying the house.
translation: Перед покупкой дома она поговорила с финансовым консультантом.

definition: to admit that you did something wrong or that you feel something
sentence: I have to {confess} I never finished that book.
translation: Должен признаться, я так и не дочитал ту книгу.

definition: a small enclosed space for one person, such as for voting or making phone calls
sentence: She stepped into the {booth} to mark her vote.
translation: Она зашла в кабинку, чтобы отметить свой голос.

definition: a person who loves their country and is proud of it
sentence: As a true {patriot}, he fought for his country's freedom.
translation: Как истинный патриот, он сражался за свободу своей страны.

definition: a safe or peaceful place
sentence: The garden is a {haven} for birds in the middle of the city.
translation: Сад — убежище для птиц посреди города.

definition: to say publicly that you support a person, product or idea
sentence: Two famous athletes {endorse} the new shoes.
translation: Два известных спортсмена рекламируют новые кроссовки.

definition: the act of agreeing to something, or of being welcomed into a group
sentence: Her {acceptance} into the university came as a surprise.
translation: Её зачисление в университет стало неожиданностью.

definition: once a year
sentence: The festival is held {annually} in the first week of June.
translation: Фестиваль проходит ежегодно в первую неделю июня.

definition: naturally existing in a place, or belonging to the people who lived there first
sentence: The museum shows the art of the {indigenous} people of the region.
translation: Музей показывает искусство коренных народов региона.

definition: without limits or end
sentence: The universe seems {infinite} when you look at the night sky.
translation: Вселенная кажется бесконечной, когда смотришь на ночное небо.

definition: used to add another fact to what has been said
sentence: The hotel is cheap; {moreover}, it is close to the beach.
translation: Отель дешёвый, и более того, он близко к пляжу.

definition: belonging to us
sentence: Their garden is bigger, but {ours} has more flowers.
translation: Их сад больше, но в нашем больше цветов.

definition: a perfect place or situation, or heaven
sentence: The island is a {paradise} for people who love diving.
translation: Остров — рай для любителей дайвинга.

definition: happening before the main or most important part
sentence: The {preliminary} results show that the drug works.
translation: Предварительные результаты показывают, что препарат работает.

definition: the job of being president, or the period of time someone is president
sentence: Her {presidency} lasted eight years and ended in 2010.
translation: Её президентство длилось восемь лет и закончилось в 2010 году.

definition: accepting things as they really are, or looking very like the real thing
sentence: Be {realistic}: we cannot finish the house in a week.
translation: Будь реалистом: мы не закончим дом за неделю.

definition: covered with large stones, or difficult and full of problems
sentence: The path to the beach is steep and {rocky}.
translation: Тропа к пляжу крутая и каменистая.

definition: the pleasant feeling you get when you achieve something or get what you wanted
sentence: She looked at the finished garden with {satisfaction}.
translation: Она с удовлетворением смотрела на законченный сад.

definition: not confident with other people; afraid to speak to them
sentence: The {shy} boy hid behind his mother when the guests arrived.
translation: Застенчивый мальчик спрятался за маму, когда пришли гости.

definition: at a time in the future or past that is not known exactly
sentence: Let's meet for lunch {sometime} next week.
translation: Давай пообедаем вместе как-нибудь на следующей неделе.

definition: in a way that must be obeyed, or exactly
sentence: Smoking is {strictly} forbidden in the hospital.
translation: Курение в больнице строго запрещено.

definition: the light and heat that come from the sun
sentence: The children played outside in the warm {sunshine}.
translation: Дети играли на улице под тёплым солнцем.

definition: a hard hat that protects the head
sentence: Always wear a {helmet} when you ride a bike.
translation: Всегда надевай шлем, когда катаешься на велосипеде.

definition: a tool with three or four points used for eating
sentence: You eat the salad with a {fork}, not a spoon.
translation: Салат едят вилкой, а не ложкой.

definition: a small restaurant where you can buy drinks and simple meals
sentence: We had coffee and cake at a {cafe} by the station.
translation: Мы выпили кофе с пирожным в кафе у вокзала.

definition: a person who collects things such as stamps or coins as a hobby
sentence: A {collector} paid a thousand dollars for the old coin.
translation: Коллекционер заплатил тысячу долларов за старую монету.

definition: a short part of a text that begins on a new line
sentence: Read the first {paragraph} and answer the question.
translation: Прочитай первый абзац и ответь на вопрос.

definition: a severe shock or injury that has a lasting effect
sentence: The accident left her with a {trauma} that took years to heal.
translation: Авария оставила у неё травму, на лечение которой ушли годы.

definition: to laugh at someone in an unkind way
sentence: The other boys used to {mock} him for his accent.
translation: Другие мальчишки высмеивали его за акцент.

definition: to jump high or a long way
sentence: The cat can {leap} from the floor to the top of the fridge.
translation: Кошка может прыгнуть с пола на холодильник.

definition: the part of a shirt or coat that covers the arm
sentence: He rolled up his {sleeve} to show the tattoo.
translation: Он закатал рукав, чтобы показать татуировку.

definition: a woman on her wedding day
sentence: The {bride} wore a long white dress and a veil.
translation: Невеста была в длинном белом платье и фате.

definition: a large wild animal like a cow with curved horns
sentence: A herd of {buffalo} crossed the river in the morning.
translation: Утром стадо буйволов перешло реку.

definition: the crime of stealing
sentence: He was arrested for the {theft} of a car.
translation: Его арестовали за угон машины.

definition: to have enough space for people or things, or to give someone what they need
sentence: The hall can {accommodate} three hundred guests.
translation: Зал вмещает триста гостей.

definition: a person whose job is to find out the facts about a crime or accident
sentence: The {investigator} interviewed every passenger on the train.
translation: Следователь опросил всех пассажиров поезда.

definition: a person who pays tax to the government
sentence: Every {taxpayer} will get a letter about the new rates.
translation: Каждый налогоплательщик получит письмо о новых ставках.

definition: an area of activity or interest, or a kingdom
sentence: In the {realm} of music, she has no equal.
translation: В сфере музыки ей нет равных.

definition: to throw things over a wide area, or to run off in different directions
sentence: The children {scatter} when the teacher appears.
translation: Дети разбегаются, когда появляется учитель.

definition: to stop someone speaking or doing something by saying or doing something
sentence: Please don't {interrupt} me while I am on the phone.
translation: Пожалуйста, не перебивай меня, пока я говорю по телефону.

definition: an official or public statement
sentence: The country made a {declaration} of independence in 1776.
translation: Страна приняла декларацию независимости в 1776 году.

definition: the subjects taught in a school or college
sentence: Music is part of the school {curriculum} from the first year.
translation: Музыка входит в школьную программу с первого класса.

definition: to move slowly and quietly so that nobody notices you
sentence: The cat began to {creep} towards the bird.
translation: Кошка стала подкрадываться к птице.

definition: the usual or expected way of behaving or doing things
sentence: Working from home has become the {norm} in many companies.
translation: Работа из дома стала нормой во многих компаниях.

definition: a feeling or opinion, especially one based on emotion
sentence: There is growing {sentiment} against the new tax.
translation: Растут настроения против нового налога.

definition: to come to the end of the period when something can be used
sentence: My passport will {expire} next month.
translation: Срок действия моего паспорта истекает в следующем месяце.

definition: a metal frame on which food is cooked over fire or heat
sentence: Put the fish on the {grill} for five minutes each side.
translation: Положи рыбу на решётку гриля на пять минут с каждой стороны.

definition: great worry, sadness or pain
sentence: The news of the accident caused her great {distress}.
translation: Весть об аварии причинила ей сильные страдания.

definition: a small change made to improve something or make it fit
sentence: The chair needs a small {adjustment} to its height.
translation: Стулу нужна небольшая регулировка по высоте.

definition: a stick of wax with a string inside that gives light when it burns
sentence: She lit a {candle} when the power went off.
translation: Она зажгла свечу, когда отключили электричество.

definition: an event or place for showing the best qualities of something
sentence: The festival is a {showcase} for young film directors.
translation: Фестиваль — витрина для молодых кинорежиссёров.

definition: a person who teaches a skill or sport
sentence: The driving {instructor} told me to check the mirror.
translation: Инструктор по вождению велел мне проверить зеркало.

definition: the regular rise and fall of the level of the sea
sentence: At low {tide} you can walk to the island.
translation: При отливе до острова можно дойти пешком.

definition: a pleasant combination of musical notes, or a state of peace and agreement
sentence: The two singers sang in perfect {harmony}.
translation: Два певца пели в полной гармонии.

definition: small balls of ice that fall from the sky like rain
sentence: The {hail} broke several windows in the greenhouse.
translation: Град разбил несколько стёкол в теплице.

definition: a priest in some Christian churches, often with a family
sentence: The {pastor} visits sick members of the church every week.
translation: Пастор каждую неделю навещает больных прихожан.

definition: a thick forest in a hot country
sentence: The explorers cut their way through the {jungle} for a week.
translation: Исследователи неделю прорубали путь через джунгли.

definition: a failure of a machine or system, or of a person's health
sentence: The {breakdown} of the bus left us waiting for two hours.
translation: Из-за поломки автобуса мы ждали два часа.

definition: salted or smoked meat from the back or sides of a pig
sentence: We had eggs and {bacon} for breakfast.
translation: На завтрак у нас были яйца с беконом.

definition: cows and bulls kept on a farm for their milk or meat
sentence: The farmer moved the {cattle} to the lower field.
translation: Фермер перегнал скот на нижнее поле.

definition: easy to use or reach, or suiting your needs well
sentence: The shop is in a {convenient} place next to the station.
translation: Магазин расположен удобно, рядом с вокзалом.

definition: old; a polite word for old people
sentence: An {elderly} man was helped across the road by a boy.
translation: Мальчик помог пожилому мужчине перейти дорогу.

definition: the study of numbers, shapes and measurements
sentence: She has a degree in {mathematics} from Oxford.
translation: У неё диплом по математике Оксфорда.

definition: the rate at which a person or company produces goods or work
sentence: New machines raised the {productivity} of the factory.
translation: Новые станки повысили производительность завода.

definition: without making much noise, or in a calm way
sentence: She closed the door {quietly} so as not to wake the baby.
translation: Она тихо закрыла дверь, чтобы не разбудить ребёнка.

definition: the direction between south and east, or the part of a place in that direction
sentence: The wind is coming from the {southeast} today.
translation: Сегодня ветер дует с юго-востока.

definition: happening or moving very quickly
sentence: The police made a {swift} arrest after the robbery.
translation: Полиция быстро произвела арест после ограбления.

definition: needing attention or action at once
sentence: I have an {urgent} message for the doctor.
translation: У меня срочное сообщение для врача.

definition: standing or pointing straight up
sentence: The wall has a {vertical} crack from top to bottom.
translation: На стене вертикальная трещина сверху донизу.

definition: a natural substance in food that the body needs to stay healthy
sentence: Oranges are full of {vitamin} C.
translation: Апельсины полны витамина C.

definition: a pain in your head
sentence: I have had a {headache} since this morning.
translation: У меня болит голова с самого утра.

definition: colored liquid used for writing, printing and drawing
sentence: The printer has run out of black {ink}.
translation: В принтере закончились чёрные чернила.

definition: a long thin line or mark, or a period of success or failure
sentence: She has a {streak} of grey in her dark hair.
translation: У неё седая прядь в тёмных волосах.

definition: to live in a particular place
sentence: The family will {reside} in Paris for two years.
translation: Семья будет жить в Париже два года.

definition: the reason why a person does something
sentence: I don't understand his {motive} for lying about it.
translation: Я не понимаю, зачем ему было об этом врать.

definition: a small imaginary creature with wings and magic powers
sentence: In the story, a {fairy} grants the girl three wishes.
translation: В сказке фея исполняет три желания девочки.

definition: money you pay to use a road or bridge, or the number of people killed
sentence: There is a {toll} of five dollars to cross the bridge.
translation: За проезд по мосту взимается плата в пять долларов.

definition: a particular quality in a person's character
sentence: Patience is not one of my strong {traits}.
translation: Терпение — не самая сильная моя черта.

definition: a person who watches something, or who is sent to watch an event officially
sentence: An {observer} from the UN watched the election.
translation: Наблюдатель от ООН следил за выборами.

definition: to move faster, or to make something happen sooner
sentence: The car began to {accelerate} as the road opened up.
translation: Машина стала разгоняться, когда дорога стала свободнее.

definition: the money you pay for a journey by bus, train or taxi
sentence: The bus {fare} has gone up again this year.
translation: Плата за проезд в автобусе в этом году снова выросла.

definition: not very cold or hot, or not strong or severe
sentence: The winter was {mild}, with almost no snow.
translation: Зима была мягкой, почти без снега.

definition: a regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements
sentence: The drummer kept a steady {rhythm} all night.
translation: Барабанщик всю ночь держал ровный ритм.

definition: a person or company that sells goods to the public in shops
sentence: The {retailer} opened ten new shops this year.
translation: Розничная сеть открыла в этом году десять новых магазинов.

definition: to join together into one, or to combine two things
sentence: The two banks will {merge} next year.
translation: Два банка объединятся в следующем году.

definition: a cure or a way to solve a problem
sentence: Hot tea with honey is my {remedy} for a sore throat.
translation: Горячий чай с мёдом — моё средство от больного горла.

definition: an article in a newspaper that gives the editor's opinion
sentence: The {editorial} criticized the government's plan.
translation: Редакционная статья раскритиковала план правительства.

definition: meat from the leg of a pig, usually salted or smoked
sentence: I would like a {ham} and cheese sandwich.
translation: Я хотел бы сэндвич с ветчиной и сыром.

definition: something that could be dangerous or cause harm
sentence: Those loose cables are a real {hazard} in a kitchen.
translation: Эти болтающиеся провода на кухне — настоящая опасность.

definition: a number of things tied or wrapped together
sentence: He carried a {bundle} of old letters under his arm.
translation: Он нёс под мышкой связку старых писем.

definition: a person who entertains people by singing, acting or dancing
sentence: The street {performer} drew a crowd with his music.
translation: Уличный артист собрал толпу своей музыкой.

definition: to describe the typical qualities of someone or something
sentence: Long hot summers {characterize} the climate of the region.
translation: Долгое жаркое лето характерно для климата региона.

definition: the act of taking money out of a bank, or of leaving a place
sentence: I made a {withdrawal} of fifty dollars from the cash machine.
translation: Я снял пятьдесят долларов в банкомате.

definition: a large bowl for washing, or a low area of land where water collects
sentence: Fill the {basin} with warm water and soap.
translation: Наполни таз тёплой водой с мылом.

definition: a change that makes something right
sentence: The newspaper printed a {correction} of the mistake the next day.
translation: На следующий день газета напечатала исправление ошибки.

definition: one of the two organs in the body that remove waste from the blood
sentence: He gave a {kidney} to his sister to save her life.
translation: Он отдал почку сестре, чтобы спасти ей жизнь.

definition: on or onto a ship, plane, train or bus
sentence: All passengers must be {aboard} ten minutes before departure.
translation: Все пассажиры должны быть на борту за десять минут до отправления.

definition: the length of time that something lasts
sentence: The {duration} of the flight is three hours.
translation: Продолжительность полёта три часа.

definition: the number 15
sentence: The bus leaves in {fifteen} minutes.
translation: Автобус отходит через пятнадцать минут.

definition: protected from a disease, or not affected by something
sentence: Once you have had the illness, you are {immune} to it.
translation: Переболев этой болезнью, ты получаешь к ней иммунитет.

definition: a general rise in prices over time
sentence: High {inflation} means your money buys less each year.
translation: Высокая инфляция означает, что на ваши деньги каждый год можно купить меньше.

definition: the strength or degree of something, such as light, feeling or activity
sentence: The {intensity} of the storm surprised everyone.
translation: Сила бури удивила всех.

definition: relating to courts, judges and the law
sentence: The {judicial} system should be independent of the government.
translation: Судебная система должна быть независимой от правительства.

definition: based on clear reasoning, or sensible and expected
sentence: It is {logical} to buy the cheaper ticket if the trains are the same.
translation: Логично купить более дешёвый билет, если поезда одинаковые.

definition: having a real purpose or importance
sentence: She wants a {meaningful} job that helps other people.
translation: Она хочет значимую работу, которая помогает другим.

definition: the direction between north and west, or the part of a place in that direction
sentence: Scotland is in the {northwest} of Europe.
translation: Шотландия находится на северо-западе Европы.

definition: relating to numbers collected and studied to show facts
sentence: There is no {statistical} proof that the drug works.
translation: Нет статистических доказательств, что препарат работает.

definition: aged between 13 and 19
sentence: Her {teenage} son spends hours playing computer games.
translation: Её сын-подросток часами играет в компьютерные игры.

definition: a sport in which two people try to throw each other to the ground
sentence: He won a gold medal in {wrestling} at the Olympics.
translation: Он выиграл золотую медаль по борьбе на Олимпиаде.

definition: to think about something all the time so that you cannot think of anything else
sentence: Don't {obsess} over one bad exam result.
translation: Не зацикливайся на одном плохом результате экзамена.

definition: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell and taste
sentence: Chop an {onion} and fry it in oil.
translation: Нарежь луковицу и обжарь в масле.

definition: a man who lives in a religious community and does not marry
sentence: The {monk} spent the morning in silent prayer.
translation: Монах провёл утро в безмолвной молитве.

definition: a plane that drops bombs, or a person who plants a bomb
sentence: The {bomber} flew low over the city at night.
translation: Бомбардировщик летел низко над городом ночью.

definition: a funny picture or video that spreads quickly on the internet
sentence: The cat {meme} was shared a million times in a day.
translation: Мем с котом разошёлся миллион раз за день.

definition: to make someone agree to do something by giving reasons
sentence: My brother {persuaded} me to try the spicy soup.
translation: Брат уговорил меня попробовать острый суп.

definition: to make drawings or models appear to move, or to make something more lively
sentence: The studio will {animate} the book's pictures for a short film.
translation: Студия оживит иллюстрации из книги для короткометражного фильма.

definition: to get involved in a situation that is not your business
sentence: Please don't {interfere} in my argument with my sister.
translation: Пожалуйста, не вмешивайся в мой спор с сестрой.

definition: a fixed limit or rule that controls how something is done
sentence: The budget sets the {parameters} for the whole project.
translation: Бюджет задаёт рамки всего проекта.

definition: a small religious group with extreme beliefs, or great popularity among a group
sentence: The film failed in cinemas but became a {cult} favourite on video.
translation: Фильм провалился в кинотеатрах, но стал культовым на видео.

definition: to push air out of your throat with a sudden loud noise
sentence: He began to {cough} as soon as he walked into the smoky room.
translation: Он закашлялся, едва вошёл в прокуренную комнату.

definition: a period of physical exercise
sentence: She does a thirty-minute {workout} before breakfast every day.
translation: Каждый день перед завтраком она делает получасовую тренировку.

definition: to fail to take care of someone or something
sentence: I've {neglected} my friends since I started this job.
translation: С тех пор как я начал эту работу, я забросил друзей.

definition: a person who has been formally suggested for a job, prize or position
sentence: The {nominee} for best actor arrived late to the ceremony.
translation: Номинант на лучшую мужскую роль опоздал на церемонию.

definition: to move slowly without a clear direction, carried by water or air
sentence: The boat {drifted} away while we were swimming.
translation: Пока мы купались, лодку отнесло в сторону.

definition: to say in court if you are guilty, or to ask with strong feeling
sentence: The driver decided to {plead} guilty to speeding.
translation: Водитель решил признать себя виновным в превышении скорости.

definition: a long line of pipes carrying oil, gas or water
sentence: The {pipeline} carries gas from the coast to the capital.
translation: Трубопровод доставляет газ с побережья в столицу.

definition: a police officer or soldier of middle rank
sentence: The {sergeant} ordered the men to wait by the trucks.
translation: Сержант приказал солдатам ждать у грузовиков.

definition: a small piece of metal or plastic with a name or picture that you wear
sentence: Don't forget your {badge}, they won't let you in without it.
translation: Не забудь свой бейдж, без него тебя не пустят.

definition: very cruel and violent, like a wild animal
sentence: The reviews of her new film were really {savage}.
translation: Отзывы на её новый фильм были просто беспощадными.

definition: to stop moving or stop something from going on
sentence: The bus {halted} right in the middle of the bridge.
translation: Автобус остановился прямо посреди моста.

definition: a point where lines or parts of a system meet or connect
sentence: Every computer in the office is a {node} on the network.
translation: Каждый компьютер в офисе — узел сети.

definition: a person who pays money to live in a house or flat
sentence: The new {tenant} upstairs plays the drums at night.
translation: Новый жилец сверху играет на барабанах по ночам.

definition: to cut a small amount off something to make it neat
sentence: Can you {trim} my hair a little before the wedding?
translation: Можешь немного подровнять мне волосы перед свадьбой?

definition: a doctor for animals
sentence: We took the cat to the {vet} this morning.
translation: Утром мы отвезли кота к ветеринару.

definition: a system where people or things take turns in a fixed order
sentence: We cook dinner in {rotation}, tonight it's my turn.
translation: Мы готовим ужин по очереди, сегодня моя.

definition: a person who moves to another place or country to find work
sentence: Many {migrants} come here for the summer harvest.
translation: Многие мигранты приезжают сюда на летний сбор урожая.

definition: to enter a place by force, especially with an army
sentence: Tourists {invade} this beach every July.
translation: Каждый июль на этот пляж обрушиваются туристы.

definition: the inside of your body where food goes, your stomach area
sentence: I had a bad feeling in my {gut} about that deal.
translation: У меня было дурное предчувствие насчёт той сделки.

definition: a performance of live music, especially by a small band
sentence: Our band has a {gig} on Friday at the pub.
translation: У нашей группы концерт в пятницу в пабе.

definition: having many parts or details, carefully planned
sentence: She made an {elaborate} cake with three floors and flowers.
translation: Она испекла замысловатый торт в три яруса с цветами.

definition: rock from which metal can be taken
sentence: The mine used to produce iron {ore}.
translation: Шахта когда-то добывала железную руду.

definition: a group of cells growing in the body in a way that is not normal
sentence: The doctors found a small {tumor} and removed it in time.
translation: Врачи нашли небольшую опухоль и вовремя её удалили.

definition: a very soft, light and expensive material made by small animals
sentence: This scarf is pure {silk}, be careful with it.
translation: Этот шарф из чистого шёлка, обращайся с ним аккуратно.

definition: to move text up or down on a screen with your finger or mouse
sentence: I {scrolled} through the menu but couldn't find the setting.
translation: Я пролистал меню, но так и не нашёл настройку.

definition: agreement with a rule, law or wish
sentence: In {accordance} with the rules, the game was replayed.
translation: В соответствии с правилами игру переиграли.

definition: very similar, almost the same
sentence: The twins look so {alike} that even their mum mixes them up.
translation: Близнецы так похожи, что даже мама их путает.

definition: true or relevant for a particular person or situation
sentence: The discount is {applicable} to students only.
translation: Скидка действует только для студентов.

definition: the fact that something can be bought, used or found
sentence: Call the hotel first to check {availability} for those dates.
translation: Сначала позвони в отель и узнай, есть ли места на эти даты.

definition: the head of government in some countries, or a senior official
sentence: The {chancellor} gave a speech about the budget tonight.
translation: Канцлер выступил сегодня вечером с речью о бюджете.

definition: the state of being awake and knowing what is happening
sentence: He lost {consciousness} for a few seconds after the fall.
translation: После падения он на несколько секунд потерял сознание.

definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
sentence: He didn't even have the {courtesy} to call and cancel.
translation: Он даже не удосужился позвонить и отменить встречу.

definition: extremely interesting, hard to stop watching or listening
sentence: Her stories about Japan are {fascinating}.
translation: Её рассказы о Японии просто завораживают.

definition: money given or lent to pay for something
sentence: We got {financing} from the bank for the new kitchen.
translation: Мы взяли в банке финансирование на новую кухню.

definition: able to change easily when the situation changes
sentence: My hours are {flexible}, so I can pick up the kids.
translation: У меня гибкий график, так что я могу забирать детей.

definition: the quality of being kind and honest
sentence: Thank {goodness} you called, I was starting to worry.
translation: Слава богу, ты позвонил, я уже начал волноваться.

definition: the bad feeling you have when you know you did something wrong
sentence: I felt a wave of {guilt} for forgetting her birthday.
translation: Я почувствовал укол вины за то, что забыл её день рождения.

definition: work that teachers give students to do at home
sentence: I can't come out, I still have maths {homework}.
translation: Я не могу выйти, у меня ещё домашка по математике.

definition: very famous and seen as a symbol of something
sentence: That red phone box is an {iconic} picture of London.
translation: Эта красная телефонная будка — знаковый образ Лондона.

definition: very interested in something and wanting to do it
sentence: She's {keen} to start the course as soon as possible.
translation: Ей не терпится начать курс как можно скорее.

definition: smaller or less important than something else
sentence: Cold coffee is the {lesser} problem here, the milk has gone off.
translation: Холодный кофе здесь меньшая беда, молоко испортилось.

definition: something that must be done because the rules say so
sentence: Helmets are {mandatory} on this ride.
translation: На этом аттракционе шлем обязателен.
